D-grouse-drive-0105.name: By East Anderson River
D-grouse-drive-0105.pressureWhy: Busier: within 1 km of a paved road (estimate).
D-grouse-drive-0105.parkWhat: pull off on Uztlius-East Anderson FSR (gravel road)

evidence.t: Road: Uztlius-East Anderson FSR, 4.2 km stretch.
2 cutblocks touch the road (30 years old or less): edges and clover.
4 wetlands, lakes or creeks along the road: riparian edges.
Black bear: young cutblocks and burns grow berries in late summer and fall (Tip).

seasonRows.notes: youth only: hunters under 18 (page footnote); New, printed green
MU 3-14 is not listed in the Region 3 sharp tailed grouse rows (my reading of the table).

plan: Drive: from Merritt, about 72 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 49.72411, -121.27944, pull off on Uztlius-East Anderson FSR (gravel road). Map links below.
Walk or drive slowly: the Uztlius-East Anderson FSR stretch, 4.2 km one way. About 84 min one way at 3 km/h.
Hunt: grouse, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Walk slowly in the first and last 2 hours of light. Watch where cutblocks and creeks meet the road (Tip).
Use: .22 rimfire for a sitting grouse inside 25 m (27 yd), or a shotgun with lead 6 or 7.5 (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 3-14, Region 3. Season: grouse Sept 10 to Nov 30 and more rows (synopsis page 34, 99%). 1 legal flag below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-04, private land 2026-09-26, closures 2026-10-03.
